changelog:
• Unthrottled Cast Streaming: Prioritizes unthrottled video streams (_no_ratelimit) directly, completely eliminating buffer bottlenecks and stuttering at 1x and 2x speeds on Android TV and Chromecast.
• Direct Cast Playback Rate: Configures Google Cast receiver pipeline directly at the target playback speed from frame 0, preventing audio/video decoder stalls.
• Offline Launch Policy & Mandatory Update: Allows up to 3 offline launches if update or maintenance servers are unreachable; strictly enforces an unbypassable update dialog on the 4th launch.
• 100% English UI consistency across all dialogs, notifications, and update feeds.
